canonicalSpine.persistence: self-contained nautilus-tile-bundle v1: raw generated recipes, deduplicated pinned template references and layout; source controls/anchors/layers/locks/seeds preserved. Meshes/caches derived.

policies.position: metres-q1e6-v1: only derived positions quantize; raw authored controls/dimensions retained
policies.direction: unit-q1e12-v1, separate from position and UV policy
policies.uv: world-linear-exact-v1; strict direct border profile/material/mapping/phase equality; explicit transition on incompatibility
policies.sampling: Analytic descriptor/evaluator identity AND agreed samples; separate segmentsPerPart/maxChordErrorM/maxSegmentM/maxWork. Interior detail cannot alter agreed border samples.
policies.topology: Explicit saddle decision separate from zero-positive classification; refuse collapsed/degenerate geometry; point contact alone is not traversable.
policies.space: Engine [x,y,h] becomes Three [X,h,Y]. N/S offsets increase world x; E/W offsets increase world y. Outward normals oppose but canonical parameter tangents do not automatically reverse.
policies.placement: World-frame descriptors include explicit clip/frame; never apply placement twice. Local elevation is origin.h+local.h, checked against floor elevation+offset, not summed twice.
policies.ownership: Every chunk retains its own border geometry. IDs are dedup hints only; unload/culling/deletion must not remove remaining seams.
policies.sharing: Actual core instance validates and compiles. Separate installations exchange detached inspected plain geometry/border/mask/readiness records, never copied kernel handles.
